survey: Object: an open paper envelope holding a stack of photo prints. Envelope body: a cream rectangle, seen from the back. The top flap is folded open and stands up behind the stack. The two side flaps and the bottom flap meet in V seams to form the front pocket. Photos: three or four white-bordered prints, fanned slightly. Their lower parts sit inside the pocket, behind the V-shaped pocket edge, and their tops stick out above the envelope between the open flap and the front. The front print shows a coastal village with a boat. Stamp and postmark: a perforated stamp with a house icon sits at the upper right of the pocket. A round postmark with wavy cancellation lines runs from the stamp onto the front. Everything rests in the pocket or is printed flat on the paper. Nothing floats, passes through another part or ends loose. The paper folds are ones real paper can make.
